remote-workspace-write.close_pending_hel: Closing does not cancel a submitted save. Continue checking it in Recent saves.
remote-workspace-write.draft_basis: Draft based on the file read at {{time}}. Saving rechecks permission and the original file digest.
remote-workspace-write.navigation_blocke: Save, discard the draft, or close it while retaining the original save command before leaving.
remote-workspace-write.reconciliation_he: The result is uncertain. Inspect the original operation without writing again; missing proof remains unresolved.
remote-workspace-write.quality_boundary: A save confirms a file operation only. Current-code checks, independent testing and acceptance are still required.
remote-workspace-write.compare_help: The left side is a newly read file snapshot; the right side is your draft. Merge changes on the right, then explicitly adopt this comparison basis.
remote-workspace-write.reviewed: I reviewed the file changes and the merged result on the right
remote-workspace-write.content_limit: Use complete, valid UTF-8 text of at most 48 KiB without null characters.
remote-workspace-write.incomplete_source: A complete file with a matching digest is required. This section cannot be edited.
remote-workspace-write.invalid_receipt: The receipt does not match the original save command. Check the original operation.
remote-workspace-write.comparison_unavai: A complete comparison file is unavailable. Keep your draft and retry.
remote-workspace-write.access_lost: Current read access has ended. Files and drafts are no longer displayed.
remote-workspace-write.history_help: Read save metadata for the current original caller without loading source bodies.
remote-workspace-write.history_truncated: Showing the latest 50 saves. Query a known command by ID using the CLI.
remote-workspace-write.error.not_started: The original write did not start; late execution has been blocked.
remote-workspace-write.error.file_change: The file changed and was not overwritten. Compare it while keeping your draft.
remote-workspace-write.error.file_missin: The original file no longer exists. No write was applied.
remote-workspace-write.error.path_not_al: This path is outside the permitted write scope.
remote-workspace-write.error.workspace_c: The execution workspace ended. New writes are no longer authorized.
remote-workspace-write.error.workspace_u: The execution workspace is unavailable. Check the original save.
remote-workspace-write.error.request_inv: The save request is invalid. Check the file and configuration.
remote-workspace-write.error.permit_expi: The save permit or unclaimed request expired. Check the original operation.
remote-workspace-write.error.operation_u: The original result cannot be proved. It remains unresolved without another write.
remote-workspace-write.error.operation_c: The original operation ID refers to different content. Check the original command.
remote-workspace-write.error.output_limi: The file or result exceeds the save limits.
remote-workspace-write.error.text_requir: Only text files can be edited.
remote-workspace-write.comparison_origin: Current file comparison snapshot, read only
